source_evidence: Generally, the interest on municipal bonds is exempt from federal income tax.
answer: Municipal bond interest is generally exempt from federal income tax. It may also be exempt from state and local taxes if you live in the state where the bond was issued. These tax benefits are not universal: a bond may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax, and state tax treatment can depend on where you live and where the bond was issued. Consider discussing a bond’s tax implications with a tax professional.
